bear_assumptions: USD 7.50 forward normalized EPS including stock compensation at 24x; AI-infrastructure growth decelerates, China remains unavailable, Rubin or supply execution raises costs, and the valuation multiple compresses.
base_assumptions: USD 9.00 forward normalized EPS including stock compensation at 28x; Q2 guidance converts, Blackwell remains strong, Rubin ships broadly on schedule, and roughly mid-70% gross margin supports continued cash generation; no unannounced Terafab economics are capitalized.
bull_assumptions: USD 11.00 forward normalized EPS including stock compensation at 34x; sovereign, enterprise, networking, hyperscale, physical-AI and orbital demand compound, Rubin expands platform breadth, and margins remain exceptional without relying on an unannounced Terafab manufacturing agreement.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade to an actionable frontier only if fresh scenarios clear expected-return, base-upside, bear/base and expected/bear payoff, margin-of-safety and confidence gates after current results; downgrade if Data Center growth or margins weaken materially, Rubin is delayed, export controls intensify, supply commitments require provisions, customer capex slows, SpaceXAI demand is immaterial, or internal customer silicon erodes platform economics.
